stem: A telemetry pipeline must ingest 8,500 records per second into a provisioned Kinesis Data Streams stream, and the team wants the minimum shard count that satisfies that write throughput.
rationale: Each provisioned shard supports up to 1,000 records per second of write throughput, so covering 8,500 records per second needs at least 9 shards, providing 9,000 records per second of capacity. Four shards cap out at 4,000 records per second and six shards at 6,000, both short of the requirement. Seventeen shards provisions roughly twice the needed capacity, more than the stated minimum calls for.
